review.assessment: The change introduces a new `solution.mjs` file containing an implementation of the `chunk` function that iterates through arrays and pushes sub-arrays only when they reach the specified size. This logic fails to add any remaining partial group after the loop finishes, causing it to drop elements at the end of an array (or all elements if the input is shorter than the chunk size), contrary to the task requirement.

findings.defect: The function returns an empty array for input arrays shorter than the chunk size.
The function drops the final partial group of elements when the array length is not divisible by size.
